beats.text: Six habits of people who can actually focus — while everyone else scrolls.
One. They work in long single blocks — one task, start to finish, no switching.
Two. They don't just silence the phone. They put it in another room entirely.
Three. They start before they feel ready. Motivation follows action, not the other way round.
Four. They batch the shallow stuff — email, admin — and fiercely protect the deep stuff.
Five. They take real breaks. Away from a screen. The mind sharpens in the gaps.
Six. They finish one thing before touching the next. Open loops drain you.
Focus isn't a talent you're born with. It's an environment you build on purpose.
